SFTPiiU - SFTP server for the Wii U
===================================

Requires a Wii U running Aroma.

Installation
------------
1. Copy the "wiiu" folder from this zip to the root of your SD card
   (merge it with the "wiiu" folder that is already there):
     wiiu/apps/SFTPiiU.wuhb
         the app, shows up in the Wii U Menu
     wiiu/environments/aroma/plugins/SFTPiiU.wps
         the plugin, keeps the server running in the background,
         in the Wii U Menu and while you play
2. Put the SD card back and restart the console.
3. Open the SFTPiiU app, or the Aroma menu (L + D-pad down + Minus,
   then "SFTPiiU"). Both show the address, the password and the
   host key fingerprint.
4. Connect with any SFTP client (WinSCP, FileZilla, Cyberduck, sftp):
     protocol  SFTP
     host      the console's IP address
     port      22
     user      anything, e.g. wiiu
     password  shown on the console

Only want the server while the app is open? Leave out SFTPiiU.wps, or
switch off "Keep running in the background" in the app's settings.

Keep the server in your home network: do not forward port 22 in your
router.

More: https://github.com/sanyahax/SFTPiiU

made by sanyahax (github @sanyahax) - ajk.dev
